mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces corporate discount rates, increasing equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that suppresses corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns exceeds 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts and real consumption expenditures signals broad demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue growth and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment rates (UNRATE > 5.0%) trigger accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC between UNRATE and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production levels indicate robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above 100, or Rank IC between INDPRO and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1300 thousand units signal weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue growth and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1300, or Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day SPX returns exceeds 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining below 100 (index 2017=100) signals economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST > 1400 thousand units) indicate robust consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1400, or Rank IC between HOUST and 60-day SPX returns is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.
